diff --git a/rich/markup.py b/rich/markup.py
index 0ffd056d..68086063 100644
--- a/rich/markup.py
+++ b/rich/markup.py
@@ -64,6 +64,12 @@ def escape(
         return f"{backslashes}{backslashes}\\{text}"
 
     markup = _escape(escape_backslashes, markup)
+    if markup.endswith("\\"):
+        # An odd number of trailing backslashes would escape whatever markup
+        # follows, so add one to make the count even.
+        trailing = len(markup) - len(markup.rstrip("\\"))
+        if trailing % 2:
+            markup += "\\"
     return markup
